# CropStudio AI

> CropStudio AI is an enterprise-grade AI product photography platform built specifically for Indian fashion and e-commerce brands. It transforms raw flat-lay photos, hanger shots, and ghost mannequins into 4K on-model studio imagery compliant with Amazon India, Myntra, Flipkart, AJIO, and Meesho.

## Key Capabilities
- **On-Model AI Try-On:** Generate photorealistic Indian urban and ethnic fashion model shoots in 3:4 and 1:1 ratios.
- **Specialized Saree AI Engine:** Realistic silk/zari draping, pleats, and pallu fall.
- **3D Ghost Mannequin AI:** Automated 1-click hollow-man neck joint rendering.
- **Bulk Background Removal:** High-precision alpha matting outputting pure white RGB 255,255,255 JPGs or transparent PNGs.
- **Marketplace Compliance Presets:** 1-click auto-formatting for Myntra (3:4, 1080x1440px) and Amazon India (1:1, 2000x2000px).

- [Myntra Model Photoshoot AI](https://cropstudio.automatexi.com/tools/myntra-model-photoshoot.html): 3:4 portrait on-model photoshoot engine with realistic Indian models.
- [Saree Model Photoshoot AI](https://cropstudio.automatexi.com/tools/saree-model-photoshoot.html): Dedicated saree and lehenga AI model draping engine.
- [Ghost Mannequin Generator](https://cropstudio.automatexi.com/tools/ghost-mannequin-generator.html): 3D invisible neck joint renderer.
- [Bulk Background Remover](https://cropstudio.automatexi.com/tools/bulk-background-remover.html): Batch alpha matting for 100+ product photos.
- [Marketplace Guidelines Hub 2026](https://cropstudio.automatexi.com/marketplace-guidelines.html): Official image specifications for Indian e-commerce platforms.
